meaning.zh: 一（个）（用于可数名词单数前，表示泛指）
meaning.en: used before a singular countable noun to refer to one person or thing, but not a particular one

sentences.en: I saw a cat in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我在花园里看见一只猫。

sentences.en: She is a teacher at a local school.
sentences.zh: 她是当地一所学校的老师。

meaning.zh: 几个；一些（用于可数名词复数，表示数量不多）
meaning.en: a small number of people or things

sentences.en: I have a few apples in the bag.

meaning.en: a large amount or number; very much; often

sentences.en: She reads a lot in her free time.
sentences.zh: 她在空闲时间读很多书。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot for your help—it made a big difference.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助——这起了很大作用。

meaning.en: Between midnight and noon; used after a time to show that it is in the morning.

sentences.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
sentences.zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

sentences.en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。

meaning.en: to give up completely or leave someone or something behind

sentences.en: Do not abandon your old friends.
sentences.zh: 不要抛弃你的老朋友。

sentences.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
sentences.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

meaning.en: the act of leaving someone or something completely, or the state of being left

sentences.en: The abandonment of the project disappointed everyone.
sentences.zh: 项目的放弃让所有人都很失望。

sentences.en: The child suffered from emotional abandonment after his parents divorced.
sentences.zh: 父母离婚后，这个孩子遭受了情感上的遗弃。

meaning.en: to become less strong or severe

sentences.en: The storm will abate by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨到明天会减弱。

sentences.en: The noise from the construction site finally abated after midnight.
sentences.zh: 午夜过后，建筑工地的噪音终于减弱了。

meaning.en: a building where monks or nuns live, or a large church that was once part of a monastery

sentences.en: Monks still live in the old abbey.
sentences.zh: 修士们仍然住在那座古老的修道院里。

sentences.en: The ruined abbey attracts thousands of visitors every year.
sentences.zh: 这座修道院遗址每年吸引成千上万的游客。

meaning.zh: 缩略，缩写（词或短语）；使简短
meaning.en: to shorten a word or phrase by leaving out letters or using only the first letters

sentences.en: We abbreviate Doctor as Dr.

meaning.en: a shortened form of a word or phrase

sentences.en: “Dr” is an abbreviation for “Doctor”.
sentences.zh: “Dr”是“Doctor”的缩写。

sentences.en: In formal writing, you should spell out an abbreviation the first time you use it.
sentences.zh: 在正式写作中，第一次使用缩写时应该写出全称。

meaning.en: to hate something very much

sentences.en: I abhor cruelty to animals.
sentences.zh: 我憎恶虐待动物的行为。

sentences.en: She abhors any form of dishonesty in public life.
sentences.zh: 她痛恨公共生活中的任何形式的不诚实行为。

meaning.en: to accept or put up with something

sentences.en: I cannot abide that noise.
sentences.zh: 我无法忍受那种噪音。

sentences.en: Companies should abide by environmental regulations even when doing so increases their production costs.
sentences.zh: 企业应遵守环保法规，即使这样做会增加生产成本。

meaning.en: the power or skill to do something

sentences.en: She has the ability to run fast.
sentences.zh: 她有跑得快的能力。

sentences.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
sentences.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

meaning.en: having the skill, power, or opportunity to do something

sentences.en: She is able to ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。

sentences.en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
sentences.zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。

meaning.en: not usual or normal, often in a way that is worrying or suggests a problem

sentences.en: The doctor found an abnormal result in the test.
sentences.zh: 医生在检查中发现了一项异常结果。

sentences.en: Regular medical screening can detect abnormal changes before they develop into conditions that require complex treatment.
sentences.zh: 定期医学筛查可以在异常变化发展为需要复杂治疗的疾病之前发现它们。

meaning.en: in an abnormal way; unusually

sentences.en: She answered abnormally during the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面试中回答得有些反常。

sentences.en: The machine started to run abnormally after the power surge.
sentences.zh: 电力浪涌之后，这台机器开始运行异常。

meaning.zh: 在船（或飞机、火车等）上；上船（或飞机、火车等）
meaning.en: on or onto a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle

sentences.en: We climbed aboard the ship at dawn.
sentences.zh: 我们在黎明时登上了船。

sentences.en: All passengers must be aboard before the ferry leaves the dock.
sentences.zh: 渡轮离港前所有乘客都必须上船。

meaning.en: to officially end a law, system, or practice

sentences.en: The king will abolish the unfair old law.
sentences.zh: 国王将废除那条不公平的旧法律。

sentences.en: Some economists argue that governments should abolish subsidies that encourage excessive consumption of fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 一些经济学家主张，政府应废除鼓励过度消耗化石燃料的补贴。

meaning.zh: 废除，废止（法律、制度或习俗）
meaning.en: the official ending or removal of a law, system, or practice

sentences.en: They fought for the abolition of the unfair law.
sentences.zh: 他们为废除那条不公平的法律而斗争。

sentences.en: The abolition of slavery was a major turning point in history.
sentences.zh: 废除奴隶制是历史上的一个重大转折点。

meaning.zh: 澳大利亚土著的；原住民的
meaning.en: of the native peoples of Australia; relating to indigenous peoples

sentences.en: He studies aboriginal art from Australia.
sentences.zh: 他研究澳大利亚的土著艺术。

sentences.en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
sentences.zh: 保护原住民语言需要持续的资金支持，并与使用这些语言的社区密切合作。

meaning.zh: 中止，使中止；放弃（计划、行动等）
meaning.en: to stop something before it is complete, or to end a plan or activity early

sentences.en: They aborted the test when the machine failed.
sentences.zh: 机器出故障时，他们中止了测试。

sentences.en: The company decided to abort the project because of rising costs.
sentences.zh: 由于成本上升，公司决定放弃这个项目。

meaning.en: the deliberate ending of a pregnancy, or the natural ending of a pregnancy before the baby can survive

sentences.en: The law allows abortion in certain cases.
sentences.zh: 法律允许在某些情况下进行人工流产。

sentences.en: The debate over abortion rights continues in many countries.
sentences.zh: 关于堕胎权的争论在许多国家仍在继续。

meaning.en: to exist in large numbers or amounts

sentences.en: The river banks abound with wild flowers.
sentences.zh: 河岸上长满了野花。

sentences.en: Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
sentences.zh: 在日照稳定且沿海风力强劲的地区，可再生能源的发展机会十分丰富。

meaning.en: on the subject of

sentences.en: We talked about our holiday plans at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

sentences.en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
sentences.zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。

meaning.en: in or to a higher place than something

sentences.en: The clock is above the door.
sentences.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

sentences.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
sentences.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

meaning.en: Mentioned or referred to earlier in a text or conversation.

sentences.en: Please bring the above-mentioned documents to our next meeting.
sentences.zh: 请把上述文件带到我们的下次会议上。

sentences.en: The above-mentioned measures could reduce urban air pollution if local authorities provide sufficient funding and oversight.
sentences.zh: 如果地方政府提供足够的资金和监管，上述措施就可能减少城市空气污染。

meaning.en: side by side and facing forward

sentences.en: The two friends walked abreast.
sentences.zh: 两个朋友并肩走着。

sentences.en: The cyclists rode abreast along the narrow road, chatting as they went.
sentences.zh: 骑行者们沿着狭窄的道路并排骑行，一边骑一边聊天。

meaning.en: To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

sentences.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
sentences.zh: 出版社为较年幼的读者推出了这部小说的删节版。

sentences.en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
sentences.zh: 出版社经常删节经典小说，使阅读经验有限的学生更容易读懂。

meaning.en: in or to a foreign country

sentences.en: My uncle lives abroad now.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔现在住在国外。

sentences.en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
sentences.zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。

meaning.en: To officially end a law, agreement, or established right.

sentences.en: The council voted to abrogate the outdated parking regulation.
sentences.zh: 议会投票决定废除那项过时的停车规定。

sentences.en: Governments should not abrogate international agreements without carefully considering the consequences for regional stability and public trust.
sentences.zh: 政府不应在未认真考虑对地区稳定和公众信任的影响时废止国际协议。

meaning.en: sudden and unexpected

sentences.en: The talk came to an abrupt end.
sentences.zh: 谈话突然结束了。

sentences.en: Abrupt changes in government policy can create uncertainty for businesses and discourage long-term investment.
sentences.zh: 政府政策的突然变化可能给企业带来不确定性，并抑制长期投资。

meaning.en: suddenly and unexpectedly; in a rude or hasty way

sentences.en: She answered abruptly during the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面试中唐突地回答。

sentences.en: The meeting ended abruptly when the manager walked out.
sentences.zh: 经理走出去后，会议突然结束了。

meaning.en: the fact of being away from a place where you are usually expected to be

sentences.en: His absence was noticed in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 会上有人注意到他缺席了。

sentences.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
sentences.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

meaning.en: not present in a place or at an event

sentences.en: Three students were absent today.
sentences.zh: 今天有三名学生缺席。

sentences.en: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
sentences.zh: 经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。

meaning.en: complete or total; not limited by anything

sentences.en: It was an absolute example in class.
sentences.zh: 那是课堂上一个绝对的例子。

sentences.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
sentences.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

meaning.en: completely; without any doubt

sentences.en: I absolutely agree with your idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意你的想法。

sentences.en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
sentences.zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接绝对必不可少。

meaning.en: to take in a liquid, gas, or other substance

sentences.en: Plants absorb water from the soil.
sentences.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收水分。

sentences.en: The sponge quickly absorbed all the spilled milk.
sentences.zh: 海绵很快吸干了洒出来的牛奶。

meaning.en: the process of taking in a liquid, gas, or other substance

sentences.en: The absorption of water by the soil is important for plants.
sentences.zh: 土壤对水的吸收对植物很重要。

sentences.en: Scientists studied the absorption of carbon dioxide by the ocean.
sentences.zh: 科学家研究了海洋对二氧化碳的吸收。

meaning.zh: 节制；禁欲（尤指不饮酒或不性交）
meaning.en: the practice of not doing something, especially not drinking alcohol or not having sex

sentences.en: He chose abstinence from alcohol.
sentences.zh: 他选择了戒酒。

sentences.en: The doctor recommended complete abstinence from smoking during the treatment.
sentences.zh: 医生建议在治疗期间完全戒烟。

meaning.en: based on ideas rather than real things

sentences.en: The painting is abstract and hard to explain.
sentences.zh: 这幅画很抽象，难以解释。

sentences.en: Abstract ideas can be difficult for young children to understand.
sentences.zh: 抽象概念对幼儿来说可能难以理解。

meaning.en: a short summary of a paper or article

sentences.en: Reading the abstract helps researchers decide whether a study is relevant to their own work.
sentences.zh: 阅读摘要有助于研究人员判断一项研究是否与自己的工作相关。

meaning.en: very silly and hard to believe

sentences.en: The excuse sounded absurd to me.
sentences.zh: 那个借口在我听来很荒唐。

sentences.en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
sentences.zh: 不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。

meaning.en: the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical

sentences.en: We laughed at the absurdity of wearing coats indoors.
sentences.zh: 我们对在室内穿大衣这件荒唐事笑了起来。

sentences.en: Critics highlighted the absurdity of building more roads while claiming to reduce dependence on private cars.
sentences.zh: 批评者指出，一边修建更多道路，一边声称要减少对私家车的依赖，这很荒谬。

meaning.en: a very large quantity of something

sentences.en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
sentences.zh: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。

sentences.en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
sentences.zh: 丰富的自然资源并不一定能保证可持续的经济增长或生活水平的提高。

meaning.en: existing or available in large quantities

sentences.en: Fresh fruit is abundant in the market.
sentences.zh: 市场上新鲜水果很充足。

sentences.en: Regions with abundant sunlight have considerable potential to generate affordable electricity from solar energy.
sentences.zh: 阳光充足的地区具有利用太阳能生产廉价电力的巨大潜力。

meaning.en: cruel or violent treatment, or the improper use of something

sentences.en: The law protects children from abuse.
sentences.zh: 法律保护儿童免受虐待。

sentences.en: Drug abuse can lead to serious health problems.
sentences.zh: 药物滥用会导致严重的健康问题。

meaning.en: related to education, study, or research

sentences.en: She has made great academic progress this year.
sentences.zh: 她今年在学业上取得了很大进步。

sentences.en: Universities should support students' emotional wellbeing rather than focusing exclusively on academic achievement and examination results.
sentences.zh: 大学应关注学生的心理健康，而不是只重视学业成就和考试成绩。

meaning.en: a school that teaches a particular subject

sentences.en: She studies music at the academy.
sentences.zh: 她在一所音乐学院学习。

sentences.en: A well-funded arts academy can provide talented young people with training they could not otherwise afford.
sentences.zh: 一所资金充足的艺术学院可以为有才华的年轻人提供他们原本负担不起的培训。

meaning.en: to agree to a request or demand

sentences.en: The manager finally acceded to our request for repairs.
sentences.zh: 经理最终同意了我们的维修要求。

sentences.en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
sentences.zh: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。

meaning.en: to take up a position of power, especially the throne

sentences.en: The king will accede to the throne next month.
sentences.zh: 国王将于下个月即位。

meaning.en: to increase speed or make something happen faster

sentences.en: The car will accelerate on the empty road.
sentences.zh: 汽车会在空旷的道路上加速。

sentences.en: Investment in public transport can accelerate the transition towards cleaner and more efficient urban travel.
sentences.zh: 投资公共交通可以加快向更清洁、更高效的城市出行方式转型。

meaning.en: the process of moving faster or happening more quickly

sentences.en: The car's sudden acceleration pushed me against my seat.
sentences.zh: 汽车突然加速，把我压向了座椅靠背。

sentences.en: The acceleration of urban growth has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
sentences.zh: 城市发展的加速增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。

meaning.en: a way of pronouncing the words of a language, especially one that shows where a person comes from

sentences.en: She speaks English with a French accent.
sentences.zh: 她说英语带有法国口音。

sentences.en: Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
sentences.zh: 教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。

meaning.en: to agree to take something

sentences.en: I accept your gift with a smile.
sentences.zh: 我微笑着接受了你的礼物。

sentences.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
sentences.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

meaning.en: satisfactory or allowed; good enough to be accepted

sentences.en: Your answer is acceptable for this test.
sentences.zh: 你的答案在这次考试中是可以接受的。

sentences.en: Governments must establish acceptable limits for industrial emissions to protect public health and nearby ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 政府必须为工业排放设定可接受的限值，以保护公众健康和周边生态系统。

meaning.en: The act of accepting something or someone; approval or agreement.

sentences.en: Her acceptance of the invitation made us all smile.
sentences.zh: 她接受了邀请，我们都露出了笑容。

sentences.en: Public acceptance of renewable energy projects often increases when local communities share in the economic benefits.
sentences.zh: 当当地社区能够分享经济收益时，公众对可再生能源项目的认可度往往会提高。

meaning.en: the right or opportunity to use or look at something; a way of entering a place

sentences.en: Students have access to the library.
sentences.zh: 学生可以使用图书馆。

sentences.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
sentences.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

meaning.zh: 同谋，从犯（法律上指协助犯罪但不在现场者）
meaning.en: a person who helps another commit a crime but is not present at the crime

sentences.en: He was charged as an accessary to the robbery.
sentences.zh: 他被指控为抢劫案的同谋。

sentences.en: In legal terms, an accessary before the fact aids the principal before the crime is committed.
sentences.zh: 在法律术语中，事前从犯是指在犯罪实施前协助主犯的人。

meaning.zh: 可到达的；可进入的；可使用的；易得到的
meaning.en: easy to reach, enter, obtain, or use

sentences.en: The garden is accessible through a small wooden gate.
sentences.zh: 穿过一扇小木门就能进入花园。

sentences.en: Public libraries should provide digital resources that are accessible to users with a wide range of abilities.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆应提供各种能力水平的用户都能使用的数字资源。

meaning.en: an item added to something to make it more useful or attractive, especially a decorative item worn with clothing

sentences.en: A red scarf is a nice accessory with that coat.
sentences.zh: 红围巾搭配那件大衣是很好的配饰。

sentences.en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
sentences.zh: 消费者常常在没有必要的情况下更换电子配件，增加了废弃物和全球对原材料的需求。

meaning.en: a sudden event that causes damage or injury, often by chance

sentences.en: A small accident happens on the road.
sentences.zh: 路上发生了一起小事故。

sentences.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
sentences.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

meaning.en: happening by chance or without intention

sentences.en: It was an accidental example in class.
sentences.zh: 那是课堂上偶然出现的一个例子。

sentences.en: The discovery was accidental, but it changed the field.
sentences.zh: 这个发现是偶然的，但它改变了这个领域。

meaning.en: by chance; without intending to

sentences.en: I accidentally deleted the file.
sentences.zh: 我不小心删除了那个文件。

sentences.en: The fire was accidentally started by a faulty wire.
sentences.zh: 这场火灾是由一根故障电线意外引发的。

meaning.en: public praise and strong approval

sentences.en: The actor won great acclaim for his role.
sentences.zh: 这位演员因其角色赢得了高度赞誉。

sentences.en: The new public library has received widespread acclaim for its accessible design and sustainable construction.
sentences.zh: 这座新公共图书馆因其无障碍设计和可持续建筑方式而广受赞誉。

meaning.en: to provide room or space for; to provide lodging for; to adapt or adjust to

sentences.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店最多可容纳500位客人。

sentences.en: The new policy is designed to accommodate the needs of working parents.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策旨在满足在职父母的需求。

meaning.en: a place to stay, especially while traveling or studying

sentences.en: We booked accommodation near the train station.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我们在海滩附近找到了便宜的住处。

sentences.en: Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.
sentences.zh: 大学应提供价格可负担的住宿，让家境困难的学生能够在不过度承受经济压力的情况下学习。

meaning.en: Music played to support a singer or main instrument.

sentences.en: My sister sang while I played the piano accompaniment.
sentences.zh: 姐姐唱歌，我弹钢琴伴奏。

sentences.en: Learning to provide musical accompaniment can help students develop listening skills and cooperate more effectively with others.
sentences.zh: 学习音乐伴奏能帮助学生培养倾听能力，并更有效地与他人合作。

meaning.zh: 伴随物；伴随发生的事物
meaning.en: Something that goes with or happens at the same time as something else.

sentences.en: The sauce is a perfect accompaniment to the fish.
sentences.zh: 这种酱汁是鱼的绝佳搭配。

sentences.en: Economic growth is often accompanied by environmental costs, and these costs are seen by some as an unavoidable accompaniment of development.
sentences.zh: 经济增长往往伴随着环境代价，而一些人将这些代价视为发展不可避免的伴随物。

meaning.en: to go or be with someone

sentences.en: Please accompany me to the shop.
sentences.zh: 请陪我去商店。

sentences.en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
sentences.zh: 城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。

meaning.zh: 同伙；帮凶（帮助他人犯罪的人）
meaning.en: a person who helps another commit a crime

sentences.en: The thief had one accomplice.
sentences.zh: 那个窃贼有一个同伙。

sentences.en: She was charged as an accomplice to the robbery.
sentences.zh: 她作为那起抢劫案的共犯被起诉。

meaning.en: to succeed in doing something

sentences.en: We accomplish our work before lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们在午饭前完成了工作。

sentences.en: Students can accomplish more when teachers provide clear goals and regular feedback on their progress.
sentences.zh: 教师提供明确目标并定期反馈学习进展时，学生能取得更多成果。

meaning.en: an official agreement

sentences.en: The two countries signed a peace accord.
sentences.zh: 两国签署了一项和平协议。

sentences.en: An international accord on emissions could encourage countries to adopt cleaner technologies and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 一项关于排放的国际协议可以鼓励各国采用更清洁的技术，并保护脆弱的生态系统。

meaning.en: agreement or conformity; used especially in the phrase 'in accordance with'

sentences.en: The rules were changed in accordance with the new law.
sentences.zh: 这些规则已依照新法律进行了修改。

sentences.en: All employees must act in accordance with the company's safety policy.
sentences.zh: 所有员工都必须按照公司的安全政策行事。

meaning.en: As stated or reported by someone or something

sentences.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
sentences.zh: 据天气预报，今晚会下雨。

sentences.en: Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.
sentences.zh: 公共资金应按当地需求分配，而不应取决于各地区的政治影响力。

meaning.zh: 根据；按照（某人或某来源所说）
meaning.en: as stated or reported by someone or something

sentences.en: According to the map, we should turn left.
sentences.zh: 根据地图，我们应该左转。

sentences.en: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
sentences.zh: 根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。

meaning.en: in a way that is appropriate to the circumstances; therefore

sentences.en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
sentences.zh: 天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。

sentences.en: Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.
sentences.zh: 学校应识别每个学生的学习需求，并相应调整教学方法，以支持所有学生。

meaning.en: an arrangement with a bank to keep money there under a person's name

sentences.en: I opened a savings account at my local bank.
sentences.zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。

sentences.en: She checked her account online to see whether the payment had arrived.
sentences.zh: 她在网上查看自己的账户，确认款项是否到账。

meaning.zh: 负有责任的；应作解释的
meaning.en: responsible for your actions and expected to explain them

sentences.en: Leaders must be accountable.
sentences.zh: 领导者必须负有责任。

sentences.en: The company is accountable to its customers for the safety of its products.
sentences.zh: 公司须对其产品的安全性向顾客负责。

meaning.en: the profession or work of an accountant

sentences.en: She studied accountancy at university.
sentences.zh: 她在大学学习会计。

sentences.en: Accountancy requires attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
sentences.zh: 会计工作需要注重细节和较强的数字能力。

meaning.en: a person whose job is to keep or check financial records for a company or person

sentences.en: The accountant checked the company's money records.
sentences.zh: 会计核查了公司的财务记录。

sentences.en: Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
sentences.zh: 聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。

meaning.en: The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.

sentences.en: My sister studies accounting and helps with our shop's finances.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐学会计，也帮忙处理我们店里的财务。

sentences.en: Accurate accounting enables businesses to monitor costs, meet legal requirements, and make informed financial decisions.
sentences.zh: 准确的会计核算使企业能够监控成本、符合法律要求，并作出有依据的财务决策。

meaning.zh: 累积；逐渐增加（尤指利息、权利、利益等）
meaning.en: to increase gradually over time, especially as interest, benefits, or rights are added

sentences.en: Interest will accrue on the loan.
sentences.zh: 贷款会产生利息。

sentences.en: The benefits of early education accrue over many years, improving both individual opportunities and wider social outcomes.
sentences.zh: 早期教育的益处会多年累积，既改善个人发展机会，也带来更广泛的社会效益。

meaning.en: accumulated over time, especially money or benefits not yet paid

sentences.en: My bank statement shows the accrued interest on my savings.
sentences.zh: 我的银行对账单显示了储蓄的累计利息。

sentences.en: Companies must account for accrued expenses to provide an accurate picture of their financial position at year end.
sentences.zh: 公司必须计入应计费用，才能准确反映年末的财务状况。

meaning.en: to gradually increase in amount or number over time

sentences.en: Dust can accumulate on the shelf.

meaning.en: The process of gradually collecting or increasing something, or the amount collected.

sentences.en: An accumulation of dust covered the old wooden shelves.
sentences.zh: 一层积灰覆盖了那些旧木架。

sentences.en: The accumulation of plastic waste in oceans threatens marine wildlife and creates lasting challenges for coastal communities.
sentences.zh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的积聚威胁着海洋野生动物，也给沿海社区带来长期挑战。

meaning.en: the quality of being correct or free from errors

sentences.en: The accuracy of these measurements is important for the experiment.
sentences.zh: 这些测量的准确性对实验很重要。

sentences.en: The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.
sentences.zh: 气候预测的准确性部分取决于长期收集的数据质量。

meaning.en: exact and correct; without mistakes

sentences.en: Her accurate answer won the prize.
sentences.zh: 她准确的回答赢得了奖品。

sentences.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
sentences.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

meaning.en: a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal

sentences.en: He denied the accusation that he had stolen the money.
sentences.zh: 他否认了偷钱的指控。

sentences.en: The accusation of corruption damaged the politician's reputation.
sentences.zh: 腐败的指控损害了这位政客的声誉。

meaning.en: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

sentences.en: Do not accuse him without facts.

meaning.en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.

sentences.en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
sentences.zh: 我慢慢让自己习惯了开窗睡觉。

sentences.en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
sentences.zh: 学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。

meaning.en: familiar with something and accepting it as normal or usual

sentences.en: I am accustomed to getting up very early.
sentences.zh: 我习惯很早起床。

sentences.en: She soon became accustomed to the noisy city life.
sentences.zh: 她很快就习惯了喧闹的城市生活。

meaning.en: to feel a continuous dull pain

sentences.en: My legs ache after the long walk.
sentences.zh: 走了很长的路后，我的双腿酸痛。

sentences.en: Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
sentences.zh: 经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。

meaning.en: to succeed in reaching a goal or producing a result, especially after effort

sentences.en: She finally achieved her goal of swimming across the lake.
sentences.zh: 她终于实现了游过湖的目标。

sentences.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
sentences.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

meaning.en: something done as a result of hard work

sentences.en: Winning the race was a great achievement.
sentences.zh: 赢得这场比赛是一项伟大的成就。

sentences.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
sentences.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

meaning.en: a chemical substance with a pH below 7 that can react with bases

sentences.en: Lemon juice contains a weak acid.
sentences.zh: 柠檬汁含有一种弱酸。

sentences.en: Acid rain can damage forests and reduce the ability of lakes to support aquatic life.
sentences.zh: 酸雨会破坏森林，并削弱湖泊维持水生生物生存的能力。

meaning.en: containing acid or having a sour taste

sentences.en: The acid taste of the fruit made her wince.
sentences.zh: 水果的酸味让她皱起了眉头。

meaning.en: to accept, admit, or recognize something as true or valid

sentences.en: I acknowledge that I made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 我承认我犯了一个错误。

sentences.en: The company acknowledged the need for stricter safety measures after the accident.
sentences.zh: 事故发生后，公司承认有必要采取更严格的安全措施。

meaning.en: The act of accepting that something is true or that someone's contribution matters.

sentences.en: He nodded in acknowledgment of his sister's helpful suggestion.
sentences.zh: 他点头表示认可姐姐提出的有益建议。

sentences.en: Public acknowledgment of past mistakes can help institutions rebuild trust and strengthen their relationships with local communities.
sentences.zh: 公开承认过去的错误有助于机构重建信任，并加强与当地社区的关系。

meaning.en: relating to sound or the sense of hearing

sentences.en: The room was designed with acoustic panels to improve sound quality.
sentences.zh: 这个房间设计了吸音板以提高音质。

sentences.en: Acoustic engineers study how sound travels through different materials.
sentences.zh: 声学工程师研究声音如何在不同材料中传播。

meaning.zh: 原声的；不使用电子扩音设备的
meaning.en: not using electric sound equipment

sentences.en: She prefers an acoustic guitar on stage.
sentences.zh: 她在舞台上更喜欢用原声吉他。

meaning.en: the scientific study of sound

sentences.en: He studied acoustics at university.
sentences.zh: 他在大学学习声学。

meaning.en: Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.

sentences.en: Please acquaint yourself with the kitchen before you start cooking.
sentences.zh: 开始做饭前，请先熟悉一下厨房。

sentences.en: Universities should acquaint new students with available support services to help them adjust to campus life.
sentences.zh: 大学应让新生了解可用的支持服务，帮助他们适应校园生活。

meaning.en: a person you have met before but do not know well

sentences.en: He is only an acquaintance, not a close friend.
sentences.zh: 他只是个熟人，不是密友。

sentences.en: Even a basic acquaintance with local customs can help international students adapt more easily to life abroad.
sentences.zh: 即使只是对当地习俗略有了解，也能帮助国际学生更轻松地适应海外生活。

meaning.en: to accept or agree to something without protest, often reluctantly

sentences.en: I will not acquiesce to unfair rules.
sentences.zh: 我不会默许不公平的规则。

sentences.en: The committee eventually acquiesced in the proposed changes after months of debate.
sentences.zh: 经过数月辩论，委员会最终默许了拟议的变更。

meaning.en: to get or gain something, especially knowledge or skills

sentences.en: Students acquire new skills in this class.
sentences.zh: 学生在这门课上获得新技能。

sentences.en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
sentences.zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。

meaning.en: the act of obtaining something or gaining knowledge or skills

sentences.en: Language acquisition happens naturally when children hear and use the language every day.
sentences.zh: 当儿童每天听到并使用语言时，语言习得会自然发生。

sentences.en: Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.
sentences.zh: 尽早接触多样的语言表达能促进语言习得，增强儿童有效沟通的能力。

meaning.en: to officially decide in a court that someone is not guilty of a crime

sentences.en: The jury will acquit the man.
sentences.zh: 陪审团将宣告这名男子无罪。

sentences.en: The court acquitted her of all charges due to lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于证据不足，法庭宣判她所有指控均不成立。

meaning.zh: 英亩（土地面积单位，约合4047平方米）
meaning.en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres

sentences.en: They bought an acre of land to build a house.
sentences.zh: 他们买了一英亩土地来建房子。

sentences.en: Protecting each acre of wetland helps preserve wildlife habitats and reduces the risk of local flooding.
sentences.zh: 保护每一英亩湿地都有助于维护野生动物栖息地，并降低当地发生洪灾的风险。

meaning.en: A performer who does difficult balancing, jumping, or gymnastic movements.

sentences.en: The acrobat balanced on one hand above the soft mat.
sentences.zh: 杂技演员在软垫上方用单手支撑身体，保持平衡。

sentences.en: Training as an acrobat requires sustained physical discipline, making injury prevention an essential part of professional education.
sentences.zh: 杂技演员的训练需要长期严格的身体训练，因此伤害预防是专业教育中不可或缺的一部分。

meaning.en: from one side of something to the other side

sentences.en: We walk across the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 我们走过那座旧桥。

sentences.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
sentences.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

meaning.en: to do something

sentences.en: We must act quickly before the water overflows from the kitchen sink.
sentences.zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。

sentences.en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
sentences.zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。

meaning.en: something that a person does

sentences.en: We must take action before the leak gets worse.
sentences.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

sentences.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
sentences.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

meaning.en: to cause something to start working or become active

sentences.en: Press this button to activate the alarm.
sentences.zh: 按这个按钮启动警报器。

sentences.en: Smart sensors can activate ventilation systems automatically when indoor air quality falls below acceptable levels.
sentences.zh: 当室内空气质量降至可接受水平以下时，智能传感器可以自动启动通风系统。

meaning.en: Having been made active or operational; set in motion.

sentences.en: The moving cat activated the light above our door.
sentences.zh: 那只走动的猫触发了我们门上的感应灯。

sentences.en: The emergency warning system was activated immediately after sensors detected unusual movement beneath the ocean.
sentences.zh: 传感器检测到海底异常运动后，紧急预警系统立即启动。

meaning.en: doing things regularly; full of energy

sentences.en: The active children play outside.
sentences.zh: 这些活跃的孩子们在外面玩耍。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

meaning.en: a thing that you do, often for interest or purpose; the state of being active

sentences.en: Painting is my favourite activity.
sentences.zh: 画画是我最喜欢的活动。

sentences.en: Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
sentences.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。

meaning.en: a person who acts in a play, film, or TV show, especially a man

sentences.en: The actor waves to the children.
sentences.zh: 那位演员向孩子们挥手。

sentences.en: Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
sentences.zh: 专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。

meaning.en: a woman who acts in a play or film

sentences.en: The actress sings on the school stage.
sentences.zh: 那位女演员在学校舞台上唱歌。

sentences.en: A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
sentences.zh: 一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。

meaning.en: real, rather than imagined, estimated, or claimed

sentences.en: The actual bill was much lower than we had expected.
sentences.zh: 实际账单金额比我们预想的低得多。

sentences.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
sentences.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

meaning.en: What really exists or happens, rather than what is imagined.

sentences.en: The flat looked spacious, but in actuality it was tiny.
sentences.zh: 那套公寓看起来宽敞，实际上却很小。

sentences.en: Although online services appear universally accessible, in actuality many rural communities still lack reliable internet connections.
sentences.zh: 尽管在线服务似乎人人都能使用，实际上许多农村社区仍缺乏可靠的互联网连接。

meaning.en: in fact; really

sentences.en: I actually like this quiet song.
sentences.zh: 我其实喜欢这首安静的歌。

sentences.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
sentences.zh: 虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。

meaning.en: very serious or severe; sharp or keen

sentences.en: She felt an acute pain in her back.
sentences.zh: 她感到背部一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: An acute shortage of affordable housing forces many young workers to live far from their workplaces.
sentences.zh: 经济适用住房的严重短缺迫使许多年轻劳动者住在远离工作地点的地方。

meaning.en: in a very strong, sharp, or severe way; keenly

sentences.en: She was acutely aware of the danger.
sentences.zh: 她强烈地意识到危险。

sentences.en: The patient complained of acutely sharp pain in his chest.
sentences.zh: 病人主诉胸部有急剧的锐痛。

meaning.en: A notice or announcement promoting a product, service, or event.

sentences.en: I saw an ad for a cooking class yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我看到一则烹饪课的广告。

sentences.en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
sentences.zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。

meaning.zh: 坚决的；固执的；不肯让步的
meaning.en: determined not to change your mind or opinion

sentences.en: She was adamant about leaving early.
sentences.zh: 她坚决要早点离开。

sentences.en: The manager remained adamant that the new policy would not be changed.
sentences.zh: 经理仍然坚决表示不会改变这项新政策。

meaning.en: to change your behavior or methods to suit a new situation

sentences.en: Animals adapt to cold weather.
sentences.zh: 动物会适应寒冷的天气。

sentences.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

meaning.en: The process of changing to suit new conditions; also a changed version of a book, play, etc.

sentences.en: It took us several weeks to get used to the cold weather, but adaptation came slowly.
sentences.zh: 我们花了几个星期才适应较冷的天气，但适应过程很缓慢。

sentences.en: Climate adaptation requires governments to improve flood defences and support communities facing increasingly frequent extreme weather.
sentences.zh: 适应气候变化需要政府改善防洪设施，并支持面临日益频繁的极端天气的社区。

meaning.en: to put something together with something else; to put numbers together to get a total

sentences.en: Add some milk to the tea.
sentences.zh: 往茶里加一些牛奶。

sentences.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
sentences.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

meaning.zh: 上瘾者；对某事物着迷的人
meaning.en: a person who is unable to stop doing or using something, especially something harmful

sentences.en: He is a coffee addict and drinks several cups every morning.
sentences.zh: 他是个咖啡上瘾者，每天早上都要喝好几杯。

sentences.en: The clinic provides support for drug addicts who want to recover.
sentences.zh: 这家诊所为想要康复的吸毒成瘾者提供支持。

meaning.en: unable to stop using or doing something, especially something harmful

sentences.en: He is addicted to video games.
sentences.zh: 他沉迷于电子游戏。

sentences.en: Many people become addicted to social media without realizing it.
sentences.zh: 许多人不知不觉地对社交媒体上瘾。

meaning.en: the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something, especially something harmful

sentences.en: He is fighting his addiction to video games.
sentences.zh: 他正在努力戒掉电子游戏瘾。

sentences.en: The clinic offers treatment for drug and alcohol addiction.
sentences.zh: 这家诊所提供毒品和酒精成瘾的治疗。

meaning.en: a thing added to something else; the act of adding

sentences.en: The salad needs the addition of salt.
sentences.zh: 沙拉需要加盐。

sentences.en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
sentences.zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。

meaning.en: Extra; added to what already exists.

sentences.en: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚有客人来，我们需要再加一把椅子。

sentences.en: Universities should provide additional financial support for students who cannot afford essential learning materials.
sentences.zh: 大学应为无力购买必要学习资料的学生提供额外的经济支持。

meaning.en: in addition; also

sentences.en: Additionally, we need more paper.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还需要更多的纸。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free breakfast; additionally, guests can use the gym at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 酒店提供免费早餐；此外，客人还可以免费使用健身房。

meaning.en: the details of where a building is, especially for mail

sentences.en: Write your address on the letter.
sentences.zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。

sentences.en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
sentences.zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

meaning.en: to deal with a problem or issue
Very skilled at doing something.

sentences.en: My sister is adept at fixing old bicycles.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐很擅长修理旧自行车。

sentences.en: Teachers who are adept at using digital tools can adapt lessons to meet a wider range of learning needs.
sentences.zh: 擅长使用数字工具的教师能够调整课程，以满足更多样的学习需求。

meaning.en: the quality or state of being enough or suitable for a particular purpose

sentences.en: We doubt the adequacy of food.
sentences.zh: 我们怀疑食物是否充足。

sentences.en: The report questions the adequacy of current safety measures.
sentences.zh: 该报告质疑现行安全措施是否充分。

meaning.en: enough or sufficient in quantity or quality for a particular purpose

sentences.en: Bring adequate water for the long walk.
sentences.zh: 长途步行要带足够的水。

sentences.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
sentences.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

meaning.en: well enough or in sufficient amounts for a particular purpose

sentences.en: This small heater adequately warms our entire bedroom.
sentences.zh: 这台小暖气足以让我们整间卧室暖和起来。

sentences.en: Schools must be adequately funded to provide all children with equal opportunities to learn.
sentences.zh: 学校必须获得充足的资金，才能为所有儿童提供平等的学习机会。

meaning.en: to stick firmly to something; to follow a rule or belief closely

sentences.en: The stamp will adhere to the card.
sentences.zh: 邮票会粘在卡片上。

sentences.en: Researchers must adhere to strict ethical standards when collecting personal information from participants in health studies.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在收集健康研究参与者的个人信息时，必须遵守严格的伦理标准。

meaning.en: next to or adjoining something

sentences.en: The park is adjacent to our school.
sentences.zh: 公园紧邻我们的学校。

sentences.en: Residents in areas adjacent to the airport often experience high levels of noise pollution.
sentences.zh: 机场邻近地区的居民经常受到严重的噪声污染。

meaning.en: a word that describes a noun or pronoun, such as 'big', 'red', or 'happy'

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to find adjectives describing weather.
sentences.zh: 老师让我们找出描述天气的形容词。

sentences.en: In academic writing, precise adjectives help readers understand complex ideas without relying on lengthy explanations.
sentences.zh: 在学术写作中，准确的形容词有助于读者理解复杂概念，而无需依赖冗长的解释。

meaning.en: to be next to or joined to something

sentences.en: Our garden will adjoin the park.
sentences.zh: 我们的花园将紧邻公园。

sentences.en: Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.
sentences.zh: 与工业区相邻的住宅区可能需要额外措施，以保护居民免受噪声和污染影响。

meaning.en: to suspend a meeting or session until a later time

sentences.en: The court will adjourn until Monday.
sentences.zh: 法庭将休庭至周一。

sentences.en: The committee decided to adjourn the debate until the following week.
sentences.zh: 委员会决定将辩论延期到下周。

meaning.en: To make an official decision about a dispute

sentences.en: An independent expert will adjudicate our dispute over the repairs.
sentences.zh: 一位独立专家将裁决我们在维修问题上的争议。

sentences.en: Independent bodies should adjudicate disputes between consumers and businesses to ensure that complaints receive fair and consistent treatment.
sentences.zh: 独立机构应裁决消费者与企业之间的纠纷，确保投诉得到公平且一致的处理。

meaning.en: to change to suit one’s situation or needs

sentences.en: It takes time to adjust to a new school.
sentences.zh: 适应一所新学校需要时间。

sentences.en: She found it hard to adjust to working night shifts.
sentences.zh: 她发现很难适应上夜班。

meaning.en: to change something slightly, especially to make it more suitable

sentences.en: Please adjust the seat before you start driving.
sentences.zh: 开车前请调整好座椅。

sentences.en: The company adjusted its prices to attract more customers.
sentences.zh: 公司调整了价格以吸引更多顾客。

meaning.en: able to be changed or adjusted to suit different needs

sentences.en: The chair has an adjustable back.
sentences.zh: 这把椅子有一个可调节的靠背。

sentences.en: The straps are adjustable so the backpack fits both children and adults.
sentences.zh: 背带是可调节的，因此这个背包大人小孩都能背。

meaning.zh: 调整；调节；（对环境的）适应
meaning.en: A small change made to improve something or to make it more suitable; the process of adapting to a new situation.

sentences.en: A small adjustment to the seat made the bike much easier to ride.
sentences.zh: 稍微调整座椅后，骑车变得更轻松了。

sentences.en: Moving to a new country often requires considerable adjustment to unfamiliar social customs and daily routines.
sentences.zh: 移居国外往往需要花不少功夫适应陌生的社会习俗和日常生活方式。

meaning.en: to manage the operation of an organization or system; to officially give or apply something such as medicine or treatment

sentences.en: Nurses administer the medicine.
sentences.zh: 护士给病人用药。

sentences.en: Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.
sentences.zh: 地方政府负责管理住房项目，为低收入家庭提供负担得起的住所。

meaning.zh: 管理；行政；（政府或机构的）行政部门
meaning.en: the management or control of an organization or business; the government or the part of a government responsible for managing public affairs

sentences.en: School administration makes the daily rules.
sentences.zh: 学校行政部门制定日常规章。

sentences.en: Efficient administration allows public hospitals to allocate resources fairly and respond more quickly to patients' needs.
sentences.zh: 高效的行政管理使公立医院能够公平分配资源，更快地回应患者需求。

meaning.en: relating to the management and organization of an institution or business

sentences.en: She does administrative work.
sentences.zh: 她做行政工作。

sentences.en: Reducing administrative costs could allow schools to spend more money on teaching materials and student support.
sentences.zh: 降低行政成本可以让学校将更多资金用于教材和学生支持服务。

meaning.zh: 令人钦佩的；值得赞赏的
meaning.en: deserving praise and respect

sentences.en: Her courage in the face of danger was admirable.
sentences.zh: 她面对危险时的勇气令人钦佩。

sentences.en: It is admirable that he admitted his mistake and tried to make things right.
sentences.zh: 他承认错误并努力弥补，这一点值得赞赏。

meaning.en: a very senior officer in the navy

sentences.en: The admiral gave orders to the fleet.
sentences.zh: 海军上将向舰队下达了命令。

sentences.en: After decades of service, he was promoted to admiral.
sentences.zh: 服役数十年后，他被晋升为海军上将。

meaning.en: a feeling of respect and approval for someone or something

sentences.en: She looked at the painting with great admiration.
sentences.zh: 她满怀钦佩地看着那幅画。

sentences.en: His courage and honesty won him the admiration of his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的勇气和诚实赢得了同事们的钦佩。

meaning.en: to respect and approve of someone or something

sentences.en: I admire her kind and brave heart.
sentences.zh: 我钦佩她善良勇敢的心。

sentences.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
sentences.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

meaning.en: the right or permission to enter a place

sentences.en: Admission to the museum is free today.
sentences.zh: 这家博物馆周日免费开放。

sentences.en: University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.
sentences.zh: 大学录取应看重学术潜力，而非仅仅让能接受昂贵私立教育的人获益。

meaning.en: to agree that something is true

sentences.en: I admit that I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我承认我错了。

sentences.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
sentences.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

meaning.en: to warn or strongly advise someone to do or not do something, often with mild criticism

sentences.en: The teacher admonished the students for being late.
sentences.zh: 老师告诫学生们不要迟到。

sentences.en: She was admonished by her manager for missing the deadline.
sentences.zh: 她因错过截止日期而被经理告诫。

meaning.en: the period of life between childhood and adulthood, usually from about 10 to 19 years old

sentences.en: Adolescence is a time of rapid physical and emotional change.
sentences.zh: 青春期是身体和情绪快速变化的时期。

sentences.en: Many mental health problems first appear during adolescence.
sentences.zh: 许多心理健康问题最早出现在青春期。

meaning.zh: 青少年（约12至18岁之间的人）
meaning.en: a young person between about 12 and 18 years old

sentences.en: The adolescent wanted more independence.
sentences.zh: 这个青少年想要更多独立。

sentences.en: Regular physical activity can improve adolescent mental health and support the development of lasting social connections.
sentences.zh: 定期运动可以改善青少年的心理健康，并帮助他们建立持久的社会联系。

meaning.en: to take someone else's child into your family and legally become their parent

sentences.en: They adopted a little girl from China.
sentences.zh: 他们从中国收养了一个小女孩。

sentences.en: The couple decided to adopt after years of trying to have a child of their own.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在多年尝试生育自己的孩子后决定收养。

meaning.en: to start using a particular method, idea, or plan

sentences.en: We adopted a simpler way to organize the shopping.
sentences.zh: 我们采用了一种更简单的方法来安排购物。

sentences.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
sentences.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

meaning.en: the act of beginning to use an idea or method

sentences.en: The adoption of online booking made appointments much easier.
sentences.zh: 采用网上预约后，约时间方便多了。

sentences.en: Wider adoption of renewable energy could reduce air pollution and create employment in rural communities.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地采用可再生能源可以减少空气污染，并为农村社区创造就业机会。

meaning.en: related to adoption or an adopted child/parent

sentences.en: She is the adoptive mother of two children.
sentences.zh: 她是两个孩子的养母。

sentences.en: Adoptive families often need extra support when a child first joins the home.
sentences.zh: 当孩子刚进入家庭时，收养家庭往往需要额外支持。

meaning.en: to like someone or something very much

sentences.en: The children adore their teacher.
sentences.zh: 孩子们非常喜爱他们的老师。

sentences.en: Although many visitors adore historic neighbourhoods, excessive tourism can disrupt the daily lives of residents.
sentences.zh: 虽然许多游客非常喜爱历史街区，但过度旅游可能扰乱居民的日常生活。

meaning.en: to decorate something or make it more beautiful by adding ornaments

sentences.en: Flowers adorn the wedding table.
sentences.zh: 鲜花装点着婚礼餐桌。

sentences.en: Public artworks adorn many urban spaces, making neighbourhoods more attractive and encouraging residents to explore their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 公共艺术作品装点着许多城市空间，使街区更具吸引力，并鼓励居民探索周边环境。

meaning.en: a thing that decorates or beautifies something or someone

sentences.en: The silver brooch was the only adornment on her dress.
sentences.zh: 那枚银色胸针是她连衣裙上唯一的装饰品。

sentences.en: Traditional jewellery often serves as personal adornment while also expressing cultural identity and social belonging.
sentences.zh: 传统首饰常常既用于个人装饰，也表达文化身份和社会归属感。

meaning.en: a fully grown person

sentences.en: An adult helps the lost child.
sentences.zh: 一位成年人帮助了那个迷路的孩子。

sentences.en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
sentences.zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。

meaning.zh: 通奸（已婚者与配偶以外的人发生性关系）
meaning.en: the act of having sex with someone who is not one's spouse

sentences.en: The story is about adultery.
sentences.zh: 这个故事讲的是通奸。

sentences.en: In some countries, adultery is still considered a criminal offense.
sentences.zh: 在一些国家，通奸仍被视为刑事犯罪。

meaning.en: to move forward, especially as part of a military attack

sentences.en: The soldiers advance across the field.
sentences.zh: 士兵们穿过田野向前推进。

sentences.en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

meaning.en: at a higher level of development, difficulty, or study

sentences.en: This is an advanced English class.
sentences.zh: 这是一个高级英语班。

sentences.en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
sentences.zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。

meaning.en: the process of developing or improving, or a promotion in rank

sentences.en: Technology has brought great advancement in education.
sentences.zh: 科技给教育带来了巨大的进步。

sentences.en: Her advancement to manager was announced last week.
sentences.zh: 上周宣布了她晋升为经理的消息。

meaning.en: a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position

sentences.en: Long legs are an advantage in running.
sentences.zh: 长腿在跑步时是一种优势。

sentences.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
sentences.zh: 公共交通的一大优势是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

meaning.en: Giving benefits or improving the chances of success

sentences.en: Booking early was advantageous because we got cheaper tickets.
sentences.zh: 提前预订很划算，因为我们买到了更便宜的票。

sentences.en: Flexible working arrangements can be advantageous to employers by improving staff satisfaction and reducing employee turnover.
sentences.zh: 灵活的工作安排能提高员工满意度、减少人员流失，从而使雇主受益。

meaning.zh: （重要事件、事物或时期的）出现，到来
meaning.en: the arrival or beginning of an important event, thing, or period

sentences.en: People waited for the advent of spring.
sentences.zh: 人们等待着春天的到来。

sentences.en: The advent of affordable renewable energy has encouraged governments to reconsider their dependence on fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 价格可负担的可再生能源的出现，促使各国政府重新审视对化石燃料的依赖。

meaning.en: an exciting or unusual experience, especially one involving risk or travel

sentences.en: Our adventure starts in the forest.
sentences.zh: 我们的冒险从森林里开始。

sentences.en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
sentences.zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。

meaning.en: a person who enjoys or seeks adventure, especially one who travels to unknown or dangerous places

sentences.en: The young adventurer set off to explore the desert alone.
sentences.zh: 这位年轻的冒险者独自出发去探索沙漠。

sentences.en: As an experienced adventurer, she always carries a map and a first-aid kit.
sentences.zh: 作为一名经验丰富的探险家，她总是随身携带地图和急救包。

meaning.en: a word that describes a verb, an adjective, or another adverb, e.g. quickly, very

sentences.en: Slowly is an adverb.
sentences.zh: slowly 是一个副词。

sentences.en: Understanding how an adverb changes emphasis can help language learners express their opinions more precisely.
sentences.zh: 理解副词如何改变强调重点，可以帮助语言学习者更准确地表达观点。

meaning.en: functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs

sentences.en: Our teacher explained adverbial phrases using simple everyday examples.
sentences.zh: 老师用简单的日常例子讲解了状语短语。

sentences.en: Understanding adverbial clauses helps language learners express relationships between events more precisely in academic writing.
sentences.zh: 理解状语从句有助于语言学习者在学术写作中更准确地表达事件之间的关系。

meaning.en: a person or group that opposes or fights against you

sentences.en: He faced a strong adversary in the final.
sentences.zh: 他在决赛中面对一个强劲的对手。

sentences.en: The company treated its main competitor as a formidable adversary.
sentences.zh: 这家公司将其主要竞争对手视为一个强大的敌手。

meaning.en: harmful or not helpful

sentences.en: We had adverse weather today.
sentences.zh: 今天天气恶劣。

sentences.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
sentences.zh: 长期接触交通噪声可能对居民的睡眠和心理健康产生不良影响。

meaning.en: in a way that has a harmful or negative effect

sentences.en: The new policy may adversely affect small businesses.
sentences.zh: 新政策可能会对小企业产生不利影响。

sentences.en: Her health was adversely impacted by long working hours.
sentences.zh: 长时间工作对她的健康造成了不良影响。

meaning.en: A difficult or unlucky situation that causes hardship.

sentences.en: Her friends stood beside her throughout years of adversity.
sentences.zh: 在多年逆境中，她的朋友一直陪伴在她身边。

sentences.en: Strong community networks can help families cope with adversity during periods of economic uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在经济前景不明朗的时期，牢固的社区关系网络能帮助家庭应对困境。

meaning.en: a notice or announcement promoting a product, service, or event; short for advertisement

sentences.en: I saw an advert for the new phone on TV.
sentences.zh: 我在电视上看到了新手机的广告。

sentences.en: The company placed an advert in the local newspaper to attract more customers.
sentences.zh: 这家公司在当地报纸上登了广告以吸引更多顾客。

meaning.en: to tell the public about a product, service, or job in order to persuade people to buy it or apply

sentences.en: Shops advertise new toys on TV.
sentences.zh: 商店在电视上为新玩具做广告。

sentences.en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
sentences.zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。

meaning.en: a notice or picture that promotes a product, service, or event

sentences.en: I saw an advertisement for a bicycle at the bus station.
sentences.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

sentences.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
sentences.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

meaning.en: The activity or business of promoting products and services.

sentences.en: My sister works in advertising and designs colourful posters.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐从事广告工作，设计色彩鲜艳的海报。

sentences.en: Advertising can influence consumer choices, which is why campaigns aimed at children require careful regulation.
sentences.zh: 广告会影响消费者的选择，因此针对儿童的广告活动需要受到严格监管。

meaning.en: an opinion or suggestion about what someone should do

sentences.en: Mum gives me good advice.
sentences.zh: 妈妈给我很好的建议。

sentences.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
sentences.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

meaning.en: sensible and likely to be beneficial; worth doing

sentences.en: It is advisable to book your tickets in advance.
sentences.zh: 提前订票是明智的。

sentences.en: Given the weather forecast, it would be advisable to postpone the outdoor event.
sentences.zh: 鉴于天气预报，推迟户外活动将是明智的。

meaning.en: to tell someone what you think they should do

sentences.en: Doctors advise us to sleep early.
sentences.zh: 医生建议我们早点睡觉。

sentences.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
sentences.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

meaning.en: someone whose job is to give guidance or expert advice

sentences.en: My advisor helped me choose courses for next term.
sentences.zh: 我的指导老师帮我选了下学期的课程。

sentences.en: A qualified financial advisor can help households plan for retirement and manage the risks of long-term investments.
sentences.zh: 合格的财务顾问能帮助家庭规划退休生活，并管理长期投资的风险。

meaning.zh: 咨询的；顾问的；建议性的
meaning.en: giving advice or having the role of giving advice

sentences.en: The school sent an advisory letter to parents about the new timetable.
sentences.zh: 学校就新课程表给家长发了一封通知建议信。

sentences.en: The committee plays an advisory role and does not make final decisions.
sentences.zh: 该委员会起咨询作用，不做最终决定。

meaning.en: an official warning or notice giving advice

sentences.en: A travel advisory was issued because of the heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 由于大雪，发布了一份旅行警报。

sentences.en: The government issued a health advisory after the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 疫情暴发后，政府发布了健康通告。

meaning.zh: 倡导；拥护（尤指对某项事业或政策的公开支持）
meaning.en: public support for or recommendation of a particular cause or policy

sentences.en: She is known for her advocacy of women's rights.
sentences.zh: 她以倡导女性权利而闻名。

sentences.en: The organization's advocacy played a key role in changing the law.
sentences.zh: 该组织的倡导在修改法律的过程中发挥了关键作用。

meaning.en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action.

sentences.en: Our neighbor advocates planting more trees along the street.
sentences.zh: 我们的邻居主张在街边多种些树。

sentences.en: Many health professionals advocate regular physical activity as an affordable way to prevent chronic disease.
sentences.zh: 许多医疗专业人士提倡定期运动，认为这是预防慢性病的一种经济实惠的方法。

meaning.en: A person who publicly supports a particular cause or policy.

sentences.en: She is a strong advocate of equal education for all children.
sentences.zh: 她是所有儿童平等接受教育的坚定拥护者。

meaning.en: a person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy

sentences.en: She is a strong advocator of women's rights.
sentences.zh: 她是妇女权利的有力主张者。

sentences.en: As an advocator for environmental protection, he often speaks at public events.
sentences.zh: 作为环境保护的提倡者，他经常在公共活动中发言。

meaning.en: in or from the air; relating to aircraft or flying

sentences.en: We saw an aerial photo of town.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了一张小镇的航拍照片。

sentences.en: Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
sentences.zh: 航空调查让研究人员能够监测偏远地区的森林流失，而不惊扰野生动物。

meaning.en: relating to aircraft or aviation

sentences.en: We saw an old aero engine at the museum.
sentences.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一台老式航空发动机。

sentences.en: Improvements in aero engine design can reduce fuel consumption and emissions from commercial aircraft.
sentences.zh: 航空发动机设计的改进可以降低商用飞机的油耗和排放。

meaning.en: relating to or requiring oxygen; (of exercise) increasing heart and breathing rate

sentences.en: Running is a popular aerobic exercise.
sentences.zh: 跑步是一种很受欢迎的有氧运动。

sentences.en: Aerobic exercise can improve cardiovascular health and endurance.
sentences.zh: 有氧运动可以改善心血管健康和耐力。

meaning.en: The study of air movement and its effects on objects.

sentences.en: We explored aerodynamics by testing paper planes in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我们在花园里试飞纸飞机，探索空气动力学。

sentences.en: Advances in aerodynamics allow aircraft manufacturers to reduce fuel consumption without significantly compromising passenger capacity or flight speed.
sentences.zh: 空气动力学的进步使飞机制造商能够降低油耗，而不会明显牺牲载客量或飞行速度。

meaning.zh: 飞机（英式英语，等于美式英语 airplane）
meaning.en: a vehicle with wings and engines that can fly through the air

sentences.en: The aeroplane flew low over the beach.
sentences.zh: 飞机低空飞过沙滩上方。

sentences.en: Travelling by aeroplane connects distant communities, but its environmental impact has encouraged debate about alternative transport.
sentences.zh: 乘飞机出行连接了相隔遥远的社区，但其环境影响引发了对替代交通方式的讨论。

meaning.en: A substance consisting of very small solid or liquid particles suspended in air or gas, or a product that releases such a spray from a pressurized container.

sentences.en: She used an aerosol to spray the dusty leaves.
sentences.zh: 她用喷雾罐喷洒那些落满灰尘的叶子。

sentences.en: Atmospheric aerosols can influence the climate by scattering sunlight and altering the formation of clouds.
sentences.zh: 大气中的气溶胶可通过散射阳光和改变云的形成来影响气候。

meaning.en: the industry or technology of aircraft and spacecraft

sentences.en: He works in the aerospace field.
sentences.zh: 他在航空航天领域工作。

sentences.en: The aerospace industry has seen rapid technological advancements in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，航空航天工业经历了快速的技术进步。

meaning.en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.

sentences.en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
sentences.zh: 这些木架让这个房间更有美感。

sentences.en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
sentences.zh: 城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。

meaning.en: a thing to be done or a matter of concern; an event or situation

sentences.en: This is a private family affair.
sentences.zh: 这是一件私人的家庭事务。

sentences.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
sentences.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

meaning.en: to have an effect on

sentences.en: Cold weather can affect the plants.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的天气会影响植物。

sentences.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
sentences.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

meaning.en: feelings of love or fondness

sentences.en: The dog showed affection to its owner.
sentences.zh: 那只狗对主人表现出亲昵。

sentences.en: Children who receive consistent affection from caregivers often develop greater emotional security and stronger social relationships.
sentences.zh: 持续得到照护者关爱的儿童，往往会形成更强的情感安全感和更稳固的社会关系。

meaning.en: showing love or warm feelings

sentences.en: She gave her son an affectionate hug.
sentences.zh: 她深情地拥抱了儿子。

sentences.en: His affectionate letter made her smile.
sentences.zh: 他那封充满爱意的信让她笑了。

meaning.en: a written statement made under oath

sentences.en: She signed an affidavit at the court.
sentences.zh: 她在法庭上签署了一份宣誓书。

sentences.en: The lawyer submitted an affidavit confirming that the documents were authentic.
sentences.zh: 律师提交了一份书面证词，确认这些文件是真实的。

meaning.en: a group or organization that is officially linked to a larger one

sentences.en: This school is an affiliate of ours.
sentences.zh: 这所学校是我们的附属学校。

sentences.en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
sentences.zh: 小型研究机构常与大学建立隶属关系，以获得使用专业设备和借助学术专长的机会。

meaning.en: to officially connect or join with a larger group or organization

sentences.en: The local club decided to affiliate with a national organization.
sentences.zh: 当地俱乐部决定加入一个全国性组织。

sentences.en: Many independent bookstores affiliate with online platforms to expand their customer base.
sentences.zh: 许多独立书店与在线平台合作以扩大客户群。

meaning.en: a connection or association with an organization, group, or cause

sentences.en: Her affiliation with the university began ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 她与这所大学的隶属关系始于十年前。

sentences.en: The candidate's political affiliations were questioned during the interview.
sentences.zh: 面试中，候选人的政治背景受到了质疑。

meaning.en: a natural liking for or close connection with someone or something

sentences.en: She has an affinity for music.
sentences.zh: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: There is a natural affinity between the two languages.
sentences.zh: 这两种语言之间有天然的密切关系。

meaning.en: To state firmly that something is true or supported.

sentences.en: Both parents affirmed their support for her career choice.
sentences.zh: 父母双方都明确表示支持她的职业选择。

sentences.en: Schools should affirm the value of cultural diversity by ensuring that teaching materials reflect different backgrounds and experiences.
sentences.zh: 学校应确保教材体现不同的背景与经历，以肯定文化多样性的价值。

meaning.en: a statement or sign that something is true or valid; the act of affirming something

sentences.en: Her nod was an affirmation that she agreed with the plan.
sentences.zh: 她点头表示她同意这个计划。

sentences.en: The positive affirmations helped him stay confident during the interview.
sentences.zh: 积极的自我肯定帮助他在面试期间保持自信。

meaning.en: to attach or stick something to something else

sentences.en: Please affix a stamp here.
sentences.zh: 请在这里贴一张邮票。

sentences.en: The contract must be signed and affixed with the company seal.
sentences.zh: 合同必须签字并加盖公司印章。

meaning.en: to cause pain or trouble to someone or something

sentences.en: A high fever can afflict young children.
sentences.zh: 高烧会折磨幼儿。

sentences.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
sentences.zh: 缺水问题持续困扰农村社区，限制农业生产，并加重当地家庭的负担。

meaning.en: having a lot of money and a high standard of living

sentences.en: They live in an affluent neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一个富裕的社区。

sentences.en: The country has become more affluent over the past two decades.
sentences.zh: 过去二十年里，这个国家变得更加富裕了。

meaning.en: to be able to pay for something

sentences.en: We cannot afford a new car now.
sentences.zh: 我们这个月买不起新沙发。

sentences.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
sentences.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

meaning.zh: 负担得起的；价格合理的
meaning.en: Inexpensive enough for most people to buy or use.

sentences.en: This small flat is affordable on my current salary.
sentences.zh: 以我目前的工资，租得起这套小公寓。

sentences.en: Governments should provide affordable housing so that essential workers can live close to their workplaces.
sentences.zh: 政府应提供可负担的住房，让必要服务岗位的工作人员能住在工作地点附近。

meaning.en: a remark or action that offends or insults someone

sentences.en: The rude joke was an affront to everyone at the table.
sentences.zh: 那个粗鲁的玩笑是对在座每个人的冒犯。

sentences.en: He regarded the offer as an affront to his professional integrity.
sentences.zh: 他把这个提议看作是对他职业操守的侮辱。

meaning.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

sentences.en: The contract says we must pay the aforesaid fee.
sentences.zh: 合同规定我们必须支付上述费用。

sentences.en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
sentences.zh: 必须满足上述条件，地方议会才能批准保护区内的任何建设项目。

meaning.en: feeling fear or worry about something

sentences.en: I am not afraid of the dark.
sentences.zh: 我不怕黑。

sentences.en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。

meaning.en: the second-largest continent, located south of Europe and between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans

sentences.en: My cousin returned from Africa with beautiful handwoven baskets.
sentences.zh: 我的表亲从非洲回来，带回了漂亮的手工编织篮子。

sentences.en: Investment in renewable energy across Africa could expand electricity access while supporting sustainable economic development.
sentences.zh: 在非洲各地投资可再生能源可以扩大电力覆盖范围，同时支持经济的可持续发展。

meaning.en: relating to Africa or its people

sentences.en: We saw several African elephants near a muddy pond.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个泥泞的水塘边发现了几头非洲象。

sentences.en: Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.
sentences.zh: 许多非洲国家正投资太阳能，以改善偏远农村社区的电力供应。

meaning.en: a person from Africa

sentences.en: She is an African who grew up in Kenya.
sentences.zh: 她是在肯尼亚长大的非洲人。

sentences.en: The conference brought together Africans from different countries to discuss regional trade.
sentences.zh: 这次会议汇集了来自不同国家的非洲人讨论区域贸易。

meaning.en: later than something else

sentences.en: We play football after school.
sentences.zh: 我们放学后踢足球。

sentences.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
sentences.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

meaning.en: the consequences or aftereffects of a significant unpleasant event

sentences.en: The town faced the aftermath of the flood.
sentences.zh: 小镇面临洪水过后的余波。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of the war, many families were left homeless.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，许多家庭无家可归。

meaning.en: the time after lunch before evening

sentences.en: We have art class this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我们今天下午有美术课。

sentences.en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
sentences.zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。

meaning.en: at a later time, following an event already mentioned

sentences.en: We watched a movie and discussed the ending afterward.
sentences.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后讨论了结局。

sentences.en: Students who review new material shortly afterward are more likely to remember it over the long term.
sentences.zh: 学生学习新内容后若及时复习，就更有可能长期记住它。

meaning.en: at a later or succeeding time

sentences.en: We watched a movie and ate dinner afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
sentences.zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

meaning.en: one more time

sentences.en: Please read the story again.
sentences.zh: 请再读一遍这个故事。

sentences.en: If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
sentences.zh: 如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。

meaning.en: touching or leaning on something for support

sentences.en: The ladder leans against the wall.
sentences.zh: 梯子靠着墙。

sentences.en: She stood with her back against the door, listening carefully.
sentences.zh: 她背靠着门站着，仔细听着。

meaning.en: opposing or not in agreement with someone or something

sentences.en: Many people are against the new law.
sentences.zh: 许多人反对这项新法律。

sentences.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
sentences.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

meaning.en: the number of years someone has lived

sentences.en: She learned to swim at the age of seventy.
sentences.zh: 她七十岁时学会了游泳。

sentences.en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
sentences.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。

meaning.en: Having reached a particular age.

sentences.en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
sentences.zh: 这门游泳课欢迎六岁及以上的儿童参加。

sentences.en: Public libraries can support children aged five to twelve by providing free reading activities during school holidays.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆可以在学校假期提供免费阅读活动，为五至十二岁的儿童提供支持。

meaning.en: Old; elderly.

sentences.en: She cares for her aged parents at home.
sentences.zh: 她在家里照顾年迈的父母。

sentences.en: The charity provides meals and companionship for aged people living alone.
sentences.zh: 这家慈善机构为独居老人提供餐食和陪伴。

meaning.en: a business or organization that provides a particular service

sentences.en: The travel agency booked our tickets.
sentences.zh: 旅行社为我们预订了机票。

sentences.en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
sentences.zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。

meaning.en: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting

sentences.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
sentences.zh: 议程上的第一项是预算。

sentences.en: Climate change is high on the government's agenda.
sentences.zh: 气候变化是政府的重要议事日程。

meaning.en: a person who looks after someone else's business affairs or acts on behalf of another

sentences.en: The agent sold the old house.
sentences.zh: 经纪人卖掉了那栋老房子。

sentences.en: Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.
sentences.zh: 当地社区团体可以鼓励居民养成更可持续的生活习惯，从而推动变革。

meaning.en: the number of years someone has lived; plural of age

sentences.en: The students in this class are all different ages.
sentences.zh: 这个班的学生年龄各不相同。

sentences.en: People of all ages came to the community event.
sentences.zh: 各个年龄段的人都来参加了社区活动。

meaning.zh: 很长时间；很久（口语，非正式）
meaning.en: a very long time (informal)

sentences.en: I haven't seen you for ages!
sentences.zh: 我好久没见到你了！

sentences.en: It took ages to finish the project, but we finally did it.
sentences.zh: 完成这个项目花了很长时间，但我们最终还是完成了。

meaning.en: to make a problem, situation, or condition worse

sentences.en: Scratching will aggravate the itch.
sentences.zh: 抓挠会加重瘙痒。

sentences.en: The new policy could aggravate tensions between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策可能会加剧两国之间的紧张关系。

meaning.en: a total formed by adding together several amounts or figures

sentences.en: The aggregate of all the scores was 450.
sentences.zh: 所有分数的总和是450。

sentences.en: In aggregate, the company's profits rose by 12% last year.
sentences.zh: 总体来看，公司去年的利润增长了12%。

meaning.en: total; formed by adding together several amounts

sentences.en: The aggregate demand for the product increased.
sentences.zh: 该产品的总需求增加了。

meaning.en: to combine or be combined into a total

sentences.en: The data were aggregated into a single report.
sentences.zh: 这些数据被汇总成一份报告。

meaning.en: the process of combining separate items into a larger whole

sentences.en: Automatic aggregation brings all my spending into one monthly report.
sentences.zh: 自动汇总功能把我的所有开销整合成一份月度报告。

sentences.en: The aggregation of regional climate data allows researchers to identify broader patterns that individual observations may miss.
sentences.zh: 汇集区域气候数据，能让研究人员识别出单次观测可能遗漏的更广泛规律。

meaning.en: angry or violent behavior or action toward others, especially an unprovoked attack

sentences.en: The country condemned the aggression.
sentences.zh: 该国谴责了这一侵略行为。

sentences.en: Verbal aggression can be as harmful as physical violence.
sentences.zh: 言语攻击可能与身体暴力一样有害。

meaning.zh: 好斗的；侵略性的；强势的
meaning.en: behaving in an angry or violent way; very forceful or determined

sentences.en: The aggressive dog barked at strangers.
sentences.zh: 那只凶悍的狗对着陌生人吠叫。

sentences.en: Aggressive marketing campaigns may increase sales, but they can also encourage unnecessary consumption and household debt.
sentences.zh: 强势营销活动可能提高销量，但也可能助长不必要的消费和家庭负债。

meaning.en: to make people angry or worried, or to argue strongly for something

sentences.en: They agitate for higher wages.
sentences.zh: 他们鼓动要求提高工资。

sentences.en: The news agitated her so much that she couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 这个消息使她焦虑不安，以至于无法入睡。

meaning.en: A state of worry or excitement that makes it hard to stay calm.

sentences.en: Her agitation grew as she searched for her missing keys.
sentences.zh: 她寻找丢失的钥匙时，变得越来越焦躁。

sentences.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise may increase agitation and reduce residents' ability to concentrate at home.
sentences.zh: 长期接触交通噪声可能加剧居民的烦躁情绪，降低他们在家中的专注力。

meaning.zh: 以前，过去（与时间词连用，表示从现在起若干时间之前）
meaning.en: before now, in the past; used with a period of time to say how far back in the past something happened

sentences.en: She talks about a trip two days ago.
sentences.zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

sentences.en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
sentences.zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。

meaning.en: To worry intensely or suffer great mental pain, especially while trying to make a difficult decision

sentences.en: I agonized over which course to choose all weekend.
sentences.zh: 整个周末，我都在为选哪门课而纠结。

sentences.en: Many graduates agonize over whether to pursue further education or enter an increasingly competitive job market.
sentences.zh: 许多毕业生为继续深造还是进入竞争日益激烈的就业市场而苦恼。

meaning.zh: 极度痛苦；剧痛（可指身体或精神上的）
meaning.en: very great pain or suffering, especially physical or mental

sentences.en: He was in agony after the fall.
sentences.zh: 摔倒后他痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: She waited in agony for the test results.
sentences.zh: 她痛苦地等待着检查结果。

meaning.en: to have the same opinion as someone

sentences.en: We all agree to play football.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。

sentences.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
sentences.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

meaning.en: pleasant and enjoyable

sentences.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我们在花园里聊天，度过了一个愉快的下午。

sentences.en: The hotel staff were agreeable and helpful throughout our stay.
sentences.zh: 在我们整个住宿期间，酒店员工都友善而乐于助人。

meaning.en: willing to accept or agree to something

sentences.en: Are you agreeable to changing the meeting time?
sentences.zh: 你愿意更改会议时间吗？

sentences.en: Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
sentences.zh: 如果管理者解释好处并回应员工的顾虑，员工可能会更愿意接受组织变革。

meaning.en: accepted or decided by everyone involved

sentences.en: We met outside the station at the agreed time.
sentences.zh: 我们在商定的时间于车站外见了面。

sentences.en: All participating countries should follow the agreed targets to ensure that collective efforts reduce carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 所有参与国都应遵循商定的目标，确保共同努力能够减少碳排放。

meaning.en: a formal arrangement or contract between two or more parties

sentences.en: They signed an agreement today.
sentences.zh: 他们今天签署了一项协议。
